asset: NASA Blue Marble clouds: global cloud coverage texture
source_record_migration_note: The former Visible Earth detail URL now redirects to the Earth Observatory index. Its cloud record remains indexed; NASA’s migrated Blue Marble article links this cloud record and describes the dataset.
credit: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center; cloud image by Reto Stöckli, with enhancements by Robert Simmon and MODIS science support.
dataset_note: A historical composite of two days of visible-light cloud observations and a third day of thermal infrared observations over the poles, as described by NASA. Not live weather.
projection: Global 2:1 equirectangular map, preserved without crop, rotation, translation or repainting.
channel_use: Grayscale cloud coverage in RGB: black represents clear/background and white represents dense clouds. Read as non-color data/mask in the shader; file has no alpha channel.
transformations: Decoded source RGB. 2048 export retains native dimensions; 1024 export uses Lanczos downsampling. WebP compression only. No semantic changes or generated cloud patterns.
